verdict.rationale: Webhook subscription is a fair capability to expect from a cloud data platform, so the axis applies, but the pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks for events. Streams (snowflake-docs-7) are in-database change capture rather than outbound HTTP delivery. The release-note line on "notification integrations for cost anomaly alerts" (snowflake-docs-33) never says these deliver HTTP webhooks a programmatic consumer can receive, so it is at most an adjacent feature and earns no credit.
